reviews.t: Hit and miss.
reviews.x: Lets be clear about this up front:  It only does one thing.  It twists a relatively small amount of hair into a braid.  And it does it quickly thanks to two AA batteries which are not included.  Lets talk about that for a moment.  If you are thinking about giving this as a present, you may want to put the batteries in the unit before you give it. reviews.t: Completely Useless
reviews.x: My 8 year old daughter paid for half of this product with her allowance and I payed for the rest. It is completely useless. You can get a better "twist" by doing it yourself in the same amount of time. It is a complete waste of money. I now have a very disappointed young girl and I myself am frustrated.

You push the switch up for the twist the hair and then down to twist the two pre-twisted strands together. However, this product still deserves less than 3 stars. Aside from the batteries not being included and having to be put in with a mini screwdriver, the clasps that hold the hair in place are very flimsy. reviews.x: if you want screaming children, purchase this torture device. It will rip hair out by the roots!

reviews.t: but she likes it better when I use it on her because I can ...
reviews.x: I bought this as a gift for my 8 year old, she loves it.  She is able to use it by herself, but she likes it better when I use it on her because I can do the back of her head which is a little bit harder for her.  This tool only twists the hair, once that part is complete then you have to turn the tool manually to finish off the "rope look"

reviews.t: Two Stars
reviews.x: Doesn't imply you have to rotate your hand for two stranded twists. That's d isappointing.

reviews.t: I really wanted to like this as I am generally a fan of Conair's ...
reviews.x: I really wanted to like this as I am generally a fan of Conair's products. However, I have to agree with many of the other reviewers that this is basically a glorified toy - and one that doesn't work. The term "braider" in the title is misleading - all this does is twist hair and it has a tendency to get the hair caught in it. Disappointing.

reviews.t: It was oversold on tv as a cool thing for young girls to do their hair
reviews.x: AWFUL! It was a Christmas present and it never worked from the beginning. It was oversold on tv as a cool thing for young girls to do their hair. We read the instructions and I (mom) was the guinea pig. It got completely twisted up and looked terrible. We tried on dolls hair, my hair several times. It's a dud! Not worth the money or effort!

reviews.t: Only twist in one direction unlike the previous model
reviews.x: The old one twisted in both directions, this newer only twist in one and you have to twist it.  Not happy with the product.

reviews.t: I bought this hoping it would make twisting faster. It did not.
reviews.x: I think this is best for people who do not know how to twist. If you already know how to make a rope twist, then this item sucks. If there are short pieces of hair, it will leave the hair looking very frizzy. I can do a better job by hand even if it's not quicker. Also, there are cheaper options that will rotate both ways. For example: https://smile.amazon.com/dp/B07373DYRD/ref=dp_prsubs_3. However, my biggest issue was the fact that the end of my daughter's twists didn't look good to me. I had

reviews.t: but I am SO disappointed! First of all
reviews.x: I did not buy this on Amazon, I bought it at Ulta, but I am SO disappointed! First of all, I thought it wasn't going to be expensive, since I used to have this as a kid and back then you could get it for ten dollars or something. No. $30!!! are you serious? You have to twist it manually anyway! AND for that wonderful $30 price, it doesn't even include BATTERIES! WTF? Lastly, to get the compartment open you need a mini screwdriver, which NOT ALL HOUSEHOLDS HAVE. This product is INFURIATING!

reviews.t: Just remember who made it and that they make good products ,,,, just not really braiding.

reviews.t: Not so good...
reviews.x: I tried this in my daughter a few times but actually making her hair look like it does on the video is really not that easy. It took a few tries before it came even remotely close to how it looks on the video and pictures.  For the brand and price, I wAs expecting more from this.  I am better off styling my daughter's hair by hand.

reviews.t: Its aight

reviews.t: If you like tangles and knots, this is the gadget for you.
reviews.x: A big waste of money! It's just a battery operated way to tangle your hair. It's also pretty pointless. I can twist my kids hair manually in the same amount of time, with less chance of damaging their hair. Really, Conair? You're ruining your good name with this gadget.

Instead of making a pretty twist it ends up spinning the hair into a very tight twist more like a tangle.  I watched video tutorials and followed instructions and still could not get a nice looking twist either by manually twisting the braider or by turning on the spinner. reviews.t: More manual use that device operated
reviews.x: It’s ok I wouldn’t recommend it though. I have seen multiple commercials that show the top portion spinning into an actual twist. This doesn’t do that. I feel like I wasted my money and I could do the individual twists by hand

reviews.x: This is definitely something you get better with over time. Easily twists or knots my daughters hair but we are finding little tricks to help not happen. We don't use this often anymore because it does take a while to get it looking just right.

reviews.t: Not what I expected... But ok product.
reviews.x: It works ok, but not how you would expect it to. It takes some time to get the twisting right. Be careful when using it and make sure to twist the device in the correct direction once turned on otherwise you are left with a tangled mess.

reviews.t: Works well. I've been using it for a while ...
reviews.x: Works well. I've been using it for a while, but I use it for making synthetic dreadlocks.  It helps make the twisting part go much faster.

reviews.t: Fun gift for my granddaughter!!
reviews.x: This was a gift for my granddaughter and she loves it!

reviews.t: Works ok..
reviews.x: Pros:- 1)It makes twists of hair in braids that are cool, beautiful & trendy. 2) It is good for creating hair patterns for parties and special occasions. 3) The kit includes 40 anti-slip mini elastics, 2 silky ribbons and 10 hair clips. 4) The product runs with 2 AA batteries that is not included in the package. Cons:- One has to twist it by hand for 2 stranded twists.

reviews.t: Great tool to twist fringe
reviews.x: I bought this to twist fringe on my weaving, not to use on a child's hair. This works great for weaving/twisting fringe. I purchased this instead of a traditional fringe twister because it's battery operated so you don't have to crank it.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the tool only twists hair rather than creating a real braid, which disappointed them.
Several reviewers complain that you still have to twist the hair manually, making the tool less useful than expected.
Some reviewers find it easy and quick to use, especially for those who can't do rope braids by hand.
A few reviewers report it rips or tangles hair and can be painful, especially for children.
Some reviewers say it works poorly on short or curly hair, leaving it frizzy or requiring careful sectioning.
